project_scope.note: Central Texas flame acanthus is taught as Anisacanthus quadrifidus var. wrightii. Bare A. quadrifidus and malformed A. quadrifidus wrightii source rows are represented by that canonical variety rather than duplicated.

priority: long orange-red to scarlet tubular bilabiate flowers
study_strategy.warning: Do not use the bare species name as a separate Central Texas learner concept. Current project taxonomy teaches the Texas native flame acanthus as A. quadrifidus var. wrightii; Hays Purola material is introduced and does not establish native Hays occurrence.

quick_key.if: Central Texas woody shrub with narrow opposite leaves and orange-red tubular hummingbird flowers
quick_key.then: Anisacanthus quadrifidus var. wrightii — canonical PASS

quick_key.if: source says Anisacanthus quadrifidus without variety
quick_key.then: map the Central Texas flame-acanthus source concept to var. wrightii; do not create a second learner
normalize malformed name to A. quadrifidus var. wrightii
